briefs.title: Camp kettle
briefs.brief: A squat tea kettle with an open overhead handle and a distinct side spout.

submissions.observation: The low faceted pot, overhead gap and short side outlet read together. The dark handle almost vanishes head-on.
A broad squat body, raised lid knob and angled pouring mouth stay distinct through the turn.
The upright body reads as a pail. The square pieces beside it scarcely read as a connected spout at 32 px.

briefs.title: Storm lantern
briefs.brief: A portable storm lantern with a warm glowing chamber and a carry loop above the cap.

submissions.observation: Warm chamber, dark cage, bright roof and open loop give a clear portable-lantern silhouette.
A clean narrow lamp and an unmistakable loop, but the luminous chamber is cool turquoise.
The wide warm chamber and loop read clearly. The oversized chamber nearly swallows the cage and base.

briefs.title: Watering can
briefs.brief: A garden watering can with a long pouring spout and a handle opposite it.

submissions.observation: The green body and long stepped spout suggest a watering can. Its handle sits over the opening instead of opposite the spout.
The pot and handle look like a bucket; the upright cone and separate disk do not make a continuous pouring spout.
The long bright spout and rose read well in profile. The tall grip bridges the center of the pot.

briefs.title: Camp stove
briefs.brief: A single-burner camp stove with a visible cooking grate and a side-mounted fuel tank.

submissions.observation: A side tank and hotplate are visible. The apparently solid orange disk offers little evidence of a cooking grate.
The grate, exposed burner, side canister and control knob have separable shapes at small size.
A dark raised grate spans an orange burner with the tank clear to one side. The stove body loses definition against the ground color.

briefs.title: Berry basket
briefs.brief: A harvest basket with a high arch handle and a heap of distinct berries peeking over the rim.

submissions.observation: The container and tall open handle read as a basket. Most of the fruit merges into the solid orange rim.
Separate orange and green berries rise above the rim; the handle and tapered basket stay coherent around the turn.
The arch and group of bright berries are legible. A side strip projects past the basket and the fruit looks particularly angular.

briefs.title: Trail pack
briefs.brief: A freestanding ranger backpack with a horizontal bedroll across its top and two contrasting straps.

submissions.observation: The front pocket, strap pair and rolled top form a recognizable hiking pack. The roll resembles a flap from the front.
The two long straps are legible but the exaggerated thin top reads like a board balanced on a column.
The front buckles and contrasting straps sell the pack. Its broad flat gray top reads as a metal plate rather than bedding.

briefs.title: Tide compass
briefs.brief: An open pocket compass with a hinged lid and a bold directional needle on its face.

submissions.observation: The two arms on the dial suggest clock hands and the narrow lid visibly floats clear of the body.
The double-ended needle and pivot survive downsampling. The broad hovering disk scarcely reads as a hinged lid.
The open cover rises from a recognizable hinge and a bold needle crosses the light dial. The face remains legible at game size.

briefs.title: Field camera
briefs.brief: A field camera with a prominent front lens barrel and a raised off-center viewfinder.

submissions.observation: The turquoise front rim and offset finder read as a camera. Thin loose-looking side and top details add noise.
The projecting barrel and small offset finder identify it. The barrel looks separated from its mount in profile.
The clear finder, substantial lens and asymmetric handgrip form a convincing compact camera around the turn.

briefs.title: Rain boot
briefs.brief: A single rain boot with an open cuff and a projecting toe above a dark sole.

submissions.observation: The profile unmistakably has a boot toe and sole, but the pale solid cap closes the cuff.
A dark recessed-looking cuff, bright rim, substantial toe and rubber sole read together from several angles.
The dark cuff inside the bright rim and block toe are clear. The very upright shaft makes the front view stiff.

briefs.title: Field radio
briefs.brief: A handheld radio with a long antenna and a front speaker grille beneath a small screen.

submissions.observation: The antenna, turquoise screen and horizontal speaker slats read even in the front 32-pixel view.
The tall antenna and stacked screen and grille make an economical, coherent handheld radio.
The antenna and display suggest a radio; the two small vertical marks below look like buttons rather than a speaker grille.

briefs.title: Ferry kiosk
briefs.brief: A ticket kiosk with an overhanging roof and a service window with a projecting counter.

submissions.observation: The contrasting overhang, dark service opening and projecting shelf make a clear compact kiosk.
The window, framed service opening, counter and deep roof form a recognizable booth even at sprite scale.
The window and shelf can be found in the large view, but the conspicuous layered stone-like roof dominates the tiny silhouette.

briefs.title: Handcart
briefs.brief: A two-wheeled box handcart with two long tow handles extending from the open load bed.

submissions.observation: The open bed and two shafts suggest a cart. Its wheel disks sit almost flat like feet.
The two contrasting handles, open load bed and paired upright wheels read as a handcart. The side wheels are distinctly diamond-shaped.
The paired bright handles identify the load carrier, but its wide flat wheel forms look like skids in profile.

briefs.title: Trail gate
briefs.brief: A walk-through trail gate with a broad open passage and an off-center hanging trail marker.

submissions.observation: A broad opening and a pale off-center tag on a visible hanger read cleanly from both faces.
The low-hanging diamond marker, cap details and wide portal form a legible trail entrance.
The heavy timber arch and small suspended marker are legible; the distinct footings ground the posts.

briefs.title: Signal buoy
briefs.brief: A floating navigation buoy with a wide banded float and a small beacon on a narrow mast.

submissions.observation: A broad striped float, thin mast and small bright beacon make a clear navigation marker.
The oversized orange float has a clear beacon, but isolated pale spots replace a legible continuous band.
Two broad contrasting bands and a framed beacon survive at 32 px. The mast cleanly joins float and light.

briefs.title: Footbridge
briefs.brief: A short plank footbridge with low railings on both sides and open approaches at both ends.

submissions.observation: Plank divisions, two open-ended approaches and slender paired rails read from both across and along the bridge.
Contrasting raised rails flank an open walkable deck with clear transverse planks and posts.
The three large boards and tall solid side walls resemble a tray. The openings at its ends do not give a clear bridge silhouette.

briefs.title: Marsh heron
briefs.brief: A long-legged heron with a bent neck and long bill, standing in profile or three-quarter view.

submissions.observation: The two legs are clear. The green neck merges into the body and the orange bill crosses or hangs away from the head in several views.
The bill, long legs and bend in the neck identify a wading bird in profile. Its upright boxy torso is stiff.
The legs and kinked neck are visible. The vertical spike beside the head looks detached and never reads as a heron's long bill.

briefs.title: Pack turtle
briefs.brief: A low four-legged turtle with a domed shell and a cargo parcel visibly strapped on top.

submissions.observation: The low green head and feet read beneath the rounded brown shell. Crossed straps secure the pale load, which dominates the small silhouette.
The small diamond head and splayed feet suggest a turtle in the larger view. The parcel rides high on posts that obscure its attachment.
The shell and cargo merge into a broad roof shape. Several gray feet appear detached and the parcel shows little evidence of a strap over it.

briefs.title: Fox courier
briefs.brief: A standing fox courier with pointed ears, a large pale-tipped tail and a side mailbag.

submissions.observation: The pointed ears, pale muzzle, coat and side satchel make a fox courier. The large tail has a visible pale tip, though its blocky segments join awkwardly.
The ears, muzzle and side bag are clear. The pale tail tip floats beside the tall orange cone in the side and rear views.
The ears and muzzle read at sprite size and the hip bag is visible. A separate pale cone alongside the orange tail breaks its outline through the turn.

briefs.title: Survey crab
briefs.brief: A low survey robot with splayed crab legs, two raised front pincers and one bright sensor.

submissions.observation: The splayed orange legs and bright mast sensor read as a crab robot. The small block pincers sit low and blend into the legs in profile.
Two raised articulated claws, a low splayed chassis and a single bright front sensor give it a clear silhouette from several directions.
The bright sensor survives at game size, but the narrow dark leg pieces appear disconnected and the blunt orange blocks scarcely read as pincers.

briefs.title: Lighthouse keeper
briefs.brief: A standing lighthouse keeper wearing a brimmed rain hat and holding a glowing hand lantern clear of the coat.

submissions.observation: The brim, long coat and separate luminous hand lantern read at game size. The lantern has a dark handle, cap and base visible through the turn.
The wide brim and bright low-hanging lantern are legible beside the coat. The arm reads as a thin diagonal bar in profile.
The brim and coat identify the figure. The bright block beside the sleeve has little visible grip or framing to identify it as a hand lantern.
